title: Leg Spin Loop And Bounce (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, leg spin is the most beautiful delivery in cricket
And the hardest to bowl
And the hardest to bat against
Now watch carefully

[Verse 1]
Ball sits in the hand between two joints
Third finger does the work, that is the point
Anti-clockwise rotation from the wrist
Leg spin out the back of the hand, do not miss

Drift in the air toward the off side wide
Loop high and land on middle or outside
Bite and turn back toward the leg stump hard
Leg spin and turn, the batters lost the yard

[Pre-Chorus]
Drift off, loop high, land and bite
Anti-clockwise wrist, bowl it right
Third finger flicks at the release point
Leg spin and turn, that is the joint

[Chorus]
Leg spin loop and bounce, turn from leg
Drift to off, loop down, land on the peg
Bite the surface, turn back sharp
Leg spin loop and bounce, the spinning art

[Verse 2]
The googly is the same grip, opposite spin
Top spinner comes straight on, no turn within
Flipper is pushed out fast and skids low
Leg spin variations, four ways to go

[Bridge]
Bluey: He has looped it up, it has drifted, bounced, and turned a full metre
Trevor: The wrist position at release determines all four leg spin variations
Chas: Son, third finger does it all. Third finger. Point it at the stumps on release.

[Chorus]
Leg spin loop and bounce, turn from leg
Drift to off, loop down, land on the peg
Bite the surface, turn back sharp
Leg spin loop and bounce, the spinning art

[Outro]
Third finger son
Third finger does it all
Thats my boy
